title: After Oasis Documentary Revives ‘Live ’25’ Tour Madness, Gallagher Brothers Will Reunite All Over Again Next Year
summary: On the Pop Shop Podcast, Katie & Keith are talking about 2027 stadium dates & the IMAX film that captured the British rockers' original reunion.
tags: Pop Shop Podcast - New Every Tuesday
contentText:
Oasis fans went from 15 years of musical silence from the British rock band to a stadium tour in 2025, an IMAX documentary in 2026, and now more stadium dates across the world in 2027 .

On the new Billboard Pop Shop Podcast , Katie & Keith are talking about all the latest news around the Gallagher brothers — Liam and Noel — who reunited once more on the red carpet at the Venice International Film Festival earlier this month for the world premiere of Don’t Look Back in Anger , a documentary about Oasis’ blockbuster Live ’25 reunion tour. And just after the film hit theaters last week, the band had another bit of news up their sleeve, releasing 38 new 2027 stadium tour dates on Monday, beginning in May in Glasgow and wrapping in September at England’s vaunted Knebworth Festival — with two new U.S. stops in the mix: Boston and Las Vegas.

Listen to our full conversation here:

Also on the show, we’ve got chart news on how Ella Langley not only returns to No. 1 on the Billboard 200 albums chart with Dandelion , but her smash hit “Choosin’ Texas” ties the record for the most weeks atop the Billboard Hot 100 songs chart. Plus, we’ve got chart news on ADÉLA, Beyonce, Ariana Grande and Karol G, plus Miley Cyrus’ new single debuting on the charts. Katie & Keith also chat about Celine Dion’s first date of her Paris residency, which included a tearful opening number and an a cappella rendition of “All By Myself.”

The  Billboard  Pop Shop Podcast  is your one-stop shop for all things pop on  Billboard ‘s weekly charts. You can always count on a lively discussion about the latest pop news, fun chart stats and stories, new music, and guest interviews with music stars and folks from the world of pop. Casual pop fans and chart junkies can hear  Billboard ‘s executive digital director, West Coast, Katie Atkinson and  Billboard ’s managing director, charts and data operations, Keith Caulfield every week on the podcast, which can be streamed on Billboard.com or  downloaded in Apple  Podcasts  or your favorite podcast provider. ( Click here to listen to the previous edition of the show  on Billboard.com.)
